description: External blind compatibility benchmark for KOMPOSOS. Pair identities are separate from audit/blind_test_pairs.json and audit/ground_truth/*.json and are not to be used for bridge tuning.
selection_policy: Thirty pairs selected from external papers, standards, handbooks, and public technical databases. Labels are evidence-backed compatibility outcomes, not outputs from KOMPOSOS. If this file is used for tuning, create a new dated blind benchmark before reporting external performance.

schema.expected_compatible: true means the pair is reported as usable/stable/standard under the cited context; false means reported incompatibility, decomposition, severe corrosion, immiscibility, or unusable interface.

pairs.citation: Wenzel et al., ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces 2016, interphase formation between lithium metal and solid electrolytes
pairs.evidence_basis: LATP is reduced by Li metal and forms an unstable interphase.

pairs.citation: Nitta et al., Materials Today 2015, Li-ion battery materials and current collectors
pairs.evidence_basis: Al foil is a standard positive-electrode current collector in LiPF6 carbonate cells.

pairs.citation: Morita et al., Journal of Power Sources 2001, aluminum corrosion in LiTFSI electrolyte
pairs.evidence_basis: LiTFSI electrolytes are associated with severe Al current-collector corrosion without inhibitors.

pairs.citation: Ohzuku et al., Journal of the Electrochemical Society 1995, zero-strain insertion material Li4Ti5O12
pairs.evidence_basis: Cu foil is used on low-potential negative electrodes, including LTO anode configurations.

pairs.citation: Zhang, Journal of Power Sources 2006, copper dissolution at high positive potentials in Li-ion batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: Cu current collector dissolves at cathode potentials.

pairs.citation: Tarascon and Armand, Nature 2001, issues and challenges facing rechargeable lithium batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: PVDF binder is standard in oxide cathode coatings including LCO.

pairs.citation: Mindemark et al., Progress in Polymer Science 2018, polymer electrolytes for lithium batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: PEO oxidation stability is inadequate for high-voltage NMC cathodes without protection.

pairs.citation: Mazouzi et al., Journal of Power Sources 2012, CMC binder for silicon negative electrodes
pairs.evidence_basis: CMC is used as an aqueous binder for high-expansion Si anodes.

pairs.citation: Li et al., Energy Storage Materials 2020, fluoropolymer binders for high-voltage cathodes
pairs.evidence_basis: PTFE-type fluoropolymer binders are chemically robust at high cathode potentials.

pairs.citation: Stephan, European Polymer Journal 2006, review on gel polymer electrolytes for lithium batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: PAN-based gel polymer systems are reported with graphite lithium-ion cells.

pairs.citation: Mikolajczak et al., Lithium-Ion Batteries Hazard and Use Assessment, Springer 2011, tab and collector materials
pairs.evidence_basis: Nickel tabs are widely used in Li-ion cell hardware and tolerate positive-electrode environments better than copper.

pairs.citation: Zhang, Journal of Power Sources 2006, current collector corrosion and high-voltage Li-ion limits
pairs.evidence_basis: Stainless steel is not a standard high-conductivity cathode current collector for high-energy NMC coatings.

pairs.citation: Li et al., Journal of Power Sources 2007, silicon anode binders including CMC/SBR systems
pairs.evidence_basis: SBR is used with CMC-type aqueous binders for high-expansion silicon anodes.

pairs.citation: Bresser et al., Energy & Environmental Science 2018, binder selection by electrode chemistry
pairs.evidence_basis: CMC aqueous binder systems are primarily anode binders and are not the standard choice for LCO cathode processing.

pairs.citation: PolymerDatabase.com, polyolefin blend compatibility notes
pairs.evidence_basis: Polyolefin pairs are commonly blended and co-processed.

pairs.citation: PolymerDatabase.com, PE/PET blend incompatibility note
pairs.evidence_basis: Nonpolar PE and polar PET are immiscible without compatibilizer.

pairs.citation: PolymerDatabase.com, acetal/PVC incompatibility notes
pairs.evidence_basis: Acetal and PVC are chemically and thermally mismatched for direct blending.

pairs.citation: Brydson, Plastics Materials, 8th edition, ABS/PMMA blend applications
pairs.evidence_basis: ABS/PMMA blends are commercial transparent or weatherable polymer blends.

pairs.citation: Victrex, PEEK/PTFE wear-grade compound technical literature
pairs.evidence_basis: PTFE-filled PEEK is a commercial wear-grade polymer compound family.

pairs.citation: PolymerDatabase.com, polystyrene/polyethylene blend immiscibility notes
pairs.evidence_basis: PS/PE blends are generally immiscible without compatibilizer.

pairs.citation: Corrosion Doctors, galvanic corrosion compatibility table
pairs.evidence_basis: Al/Cu direct contact has high galvanic corrosion risk in conductive environments.

pairs.citation: Titanium Industries, titanium grade properties and fabrication guidance
pairs.evidence_basis: Commercially pure titanium and Ti-6Al-4V are same-base titanium materials with compatible passivation.

pairs.citation: Copper Development Association, copper alloy families and joining guidance
pairs.evidence_basis: Copper-alloy family pairing with modest galvanic and metallurgical mismatch.

pairs.citation: Special Metals, INCONEL alloy datasheets and joining guidance
pairs.evidence_basis: Nickel superalloys 625 and 718 are same-base alloy systems used in high-temperature assemblies.

pairs.citation: ASM Specialty Handbook: Aluminum and Aluminum Alloys, 1993
pairs.evidence_basis: Aluminum alloys are close in galvanic potential and can be mechanically joined with appropriate practice.

pairs.citation: Shelby, Introduction to Glass Science and Technology, 2nd edition
pairs.evidence_basis: Soda-lime glass is a silica-based glass family.

pairs.citation: Auvergniot et al., Chemistry of Materials 2017, interface stability of sulfide solid electrolytes
pairs.evidence_basis: Sulfide solid electrolytes can form high-impedance oxide interfaces with alumina-type oxides.

pairs.citation: Thevenot, Journal of the European Ceramic Society 1990, boron carbide and silicon carbide ceramics
pairs.evidence_basis: B4C/TiC carbide composites are reported non-oxide ceramic systems.

pairs.citation: Adachi, Properties of Semiconductor Alloys: Group-IV, III-V and II-VI Semiconductors, 2009
pairs.evidence_basis: CdTe/ZnSe is a II-VI semiconductor pairing with closer chemistry than mixed III-V/IV systems.

pairs.citation: RP Photonics Encyclopedia, fluoride glass fibers and silica fiber incompatibility notes
pairs.evidence_basis: Fluoride glass and silica have incompatible thermal/chemical processing windows for direct fusion.
